name: oncl_3env_median_nn_noise_default
description: Default ONCL noise-level sweep for 12d_dual_arm_traj, 3d_vz_2d_ellipse_traj, and 6d_surf_normal_traj. Gaussian training noise is scaled by the clean training set median nearest-neighbor L2 distance: target_rms_l2 = alpha * median_nn_l2, per_dim_sigma = target_rms_l2 / sqrt(data_dim).

noise.formula: median_nn_l2 = median_i min_{j != i} ||x_i - x_j||_2; per_dim_sigma = alpha * median_nn_l2 / sqrt(data_dim); x_noisy = x_clean + Normal(0, per_dim_sigma^2 I)
noise.angle_postprocess: wrap RPY dimensions to [-pi, pi] after adding noise

eval_policy: Evaluation remains clean; noise is applied only to training demonstrations.
run_parallel_template: conda run -n segment python -m runners.run_parallel --methods oncl --datasets 12d_dual_arm_traj,3d_vz_2d_ellipse_traj,6d_surf_normal_traj --seeds 0,1,2,3,4,5,6 --sweep train_noise_median_nn_alpha=0.0,0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0 --override train_noise_enable=true --override train_noise_mode=median_nn_l2_gaussian --outdir outputs/bench/oncl_3env_median_nn_noise_7seed --workers 4 --resume
